STATUS: ANSWER
Run `build_docker_remote.sh` to build the GATK4 image with Google Cloud Build. This is useful if you cannot build the image locally [gatk_docker#h001]. First run `gcloud config set project <PROJECT>` with a project that has access to Google Cloud Build [gatk_docker#h001]. Then run `sudo bash build_docker_remote.sh -e ${GITHUB_TAG} -d ${STAGING_DIR}` [gatk_docker#h004]. The image is tagged `us.gcr.io/broad-dsde-methods/broad-gatk-snapshots/gatk-remote-builds:<USERNAME>-<GITHUB_TAG>-<GIT_HASH>` and uploaded to GCR [gatk_docker#h004]. For the gatkbase image, the remote script is `build_docker_base_cloud.sh <docker_image_version>` [gatk_docker#h011].
